# zerops_service (Data Source)

Look up a service by ID or project_id and hostname. Does not reconcile lifecycle.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "zerops_service" "app" {
  project_id = zerops_project.example.id
  hostname   = "app"
}

# Alternatively, select by ID alone:
data "zerops_service" "by_id" {
  id = data.zerops_service.app.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `hostname` (String) Service hostname; required with project_id.
- `id` (String) Service ID; exclusive with the project_id/hostname selector.
- `project_id` (String) Parent project ID; required with hostname.

### Read-Only

- `active_app_version_id` (String) Active app-version ID; null before a deployment.
- `base` (String) Canonical service type.
- `created` (String) RFC3339 creation timestamp.
- `current_autoscaling` (Attributes) Effective autoscaling, including defaults. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--current_autoscaling))
- `ports` (Attributes List) Declared backend ports sorted by protocol and port. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ports))
- `status` (String) Raw service status.
- `subdomain_access` (Boolean) Whether generated HTTP subdomain access is enabled.
